verdict: DEAD (the judge's pre-registered step-1 kill, ideal bound > 14.0, fires on both benches): the IDEAL bound (lead-quality chain = conecut's own fitted metal, frozen, K welded, drive stripped, knee-side samples dropped, J3 re-aim wdir(95, -8.2) b3 0 asserted, psi2 -45 -> a2 67.34, relay PHI 45 about raxis(8.75, -90), NO J4 metal) reads 16.86 frozen exact Bench(110,360) (reach 0.792, follow 0.936, ib14 0.921, 19 contacts / 101.9 mm, overhead 7/28) and 19.70 on envsel (reach 0.767, overhead 5/26); best of 6 ideal cells (a2 62 / 67 / 72-ish, PHI 45 / 50, J3 stops, q2 dowel, J3 wdir(90, -8.2), and the no-re-aim control 36.15). Reach + follow alone cost 14.7 envsel points and J4 metal cannot add reach. The J4 hardware built across the full 26 mm width (2D-contoured band at q 1, race a surface of revolution, carriage, 4 wheel blocks, 95 mm strap) reads 74.53 frozen exact Bench(110,360) (79.79 envsel): carriage in band 0.34 (floats 10-22 mm: the race must clear the worst skin per azimuth), strap contacts on 54 poses, band vs torso 10. Row fields carry the hardware reading (every part sampled); the ideal is in ideal_frozen_exact.
limiter: reach on the ideal: 75 of 360 ws lost on Bench(110,360) exact frozen - fold 54 (no welded solution within PHI 45), hub-2 burials 12 (under the acromion at abduction 105-150, to 14.4 mm, the price of the psi2 -45 J2 re-placement), J3 stop 6, parts 3; then the J4 hardware: the arm-fixed race must clear the skin's per-azimuth maximum (skin swings 6-12 mm vs the humerus frame at s 0.30), so the carriage floats out of band (0.34), the strap meets the deltoid bunching (54 poses <= 2.6 mm) and the band meets the torso at across-body / extreme axial rotation (10 poses <= 12 mm)

mechanism.notes: J1-J3 O20 v5 stacks on MR117-2RS pairs, K welded (link 1 one bar), J2 own-angle dowel stops, J3 dowel stop; J4 = roller carriage (4 x MR63ZZ in 17-4PH V-sleeves on M3 shoulder studs, eccentric preload) on an arm-fixed 17-4PH C-band race on a 2D-contoured Ti saddle fused into BOTTOM's cut end at s 0.30; 2 N constant-force strip to the zero dowel, end dowel at PHI; member 3 = hub-3 plate + 12 x 3 Ti strap; no knee, no cuff slides
